title: Ward Clinical Dashboard
description: Answers the business question: which patients are concerning right now, and how do yesterday's labs change the picture?

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM speed.clinical_alerts WHERE NOT acknowledged AND raised_at >= now() - interval '60 minutes') + (SELECT count(*) FROM speed.vitals_alerts WHERE NOT acknowledged AND raised_at >= now() - interval '60 minutes') AS "Active alerts (60 min)"
SELECT count(*) AS "High risk" FROM serving.patient_360 WHERE current_risk_band = 'high' AND current_window_start >= now() - interval '3 minutes'

SELECT current_risk_band AS "band", count(*) AS "count" FROM serving.patient_360 WHERE current_risk_band IS NOT NULL AND current_window_start >= now() - interval '3 minutes' GROUP BY current_risk_band

SELECT patient_id, name, ward, bed, current_score, current_risk_band, current_trend, batch_adjusted_score, batch_risk_band, batch_delta_direction FROM serving.patient_360 ORDER BY current_score DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Heart rate -- last hour, all patients

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_ts AS "time", patient_id, heart_rate FROM speed.vitals_clean WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '1 hour' ORDER BY event_ts
SELECT raised_at, patient_id, score, risk_band, acknowledged FROM speed.clinical_alerts ORDER BY raised_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT sim_day, patient_id, vitals_score, vitals_band, abnormal_test_count, adjusted_risk_score, risk_band, reason_codes, score_delta, delta_direction FROM batch.patient_risk_daily ORDER BY sim_day DESC, adjusted_risk_score DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Immediate spike alerts (speed layer: SpO2 < 90, HR > 130, ...)

targets.rawSql: SELECT raised_at, patient_id, rule, observed_value, threshold, acknowledged FROM speed.vitals_alerts ORDER BY raised_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Abnormal lab results feeding the risk score (batch layer)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sim_day, patient_id, test_type, result_value, unit, flag FROM batch.patient_lab_results WHERE flag IN ('low','high') ORDER BY sim_day DESC, patient_id, test_type LIMIT 100
